build_symmetric_alignments: build symmetric word alignments for a translation dataset using fast_align and mosesdecoder
run_forward_alignment: run forward fast_align on a joined source-target parallel corpus file
run_backward_alignment: run backward fast_align on a joined source-target parallel corpus file
join_parallel_corpus: join source and target language sentence files into a single delimited corpus file
symmetrize_alignments: symmetrize forward and backward alignments using a configurable heuristic like grow-diag-final-and
